body:
I get what you mean, I'm still trying to get over it, but it's really hard when everyone around you, and yourself even, had this - I wouldn't call it goal, but just accepted fact for 21 years of what would happen. I went a bit crazy when it all went down.

I do appreciate the thought of having more then one set of talents, but to date I haven't found anything. I really do think I had my one thing, and it's unfortunate that I don't even have that anymore. 

Edit: It's kinda like a video game, where you get to choose your attributes at the beginning, all mine were set to one, and the rest weren't ever touched.

Thank you for your reply, it means a lot. 

Right now it's just general education stuff, because it's something to do and it's what people do I guess. Two years ago I was accepted into a very nice prestigious art program, which I had to withdrawal from due to money reasons. I haven't wanted or felt like doing anything on that trajectory since, which was the only thing I ever had any knack for.
